evidence.quote: AIP is our generative artificial intelligence (“AI”) platform, which provides secure connectivity to third-party-provided large language models (“LLMs”), a development toolchain for building AI-powered agents and automations, an array of AI-enabled end user applications, a broad evaluations framework for governing AI workflows in production, and more.
